title: Plain format readers and adapter maps across compiler, runtime, kb and workspace-runtime
summary: Readers across @inventarch/agent-composition-system, @inventarch/cli, @inventarch/kb, @inventarch/runtime and @inventarch/workspace-runtime accept plain format names beside formatVersion 1 (compiled-harness, task-context-declaration, task-capture-selection, position-body, position-packet, delivery-view, packet-receipt, method-bytes, kb-package, kb-selection, kb-portable, kb-citation, kb-snapshot, kb-foundation, captured-resources, authoring-resources, authoring-index, authoring-view, installed-adapter, retained-store, lifecycle-profile, lifecycle-event, lifecycle-context, lifecycle-context-segment, prepared-lifecycle-context, native-context, projection-descriptor, projection-manifest, projection-result, projection-catalog, lowering-map and managed-draft) as well as the plain prose profile ids (claude-prose, codex-prose) and handler ids (corpus-inspect, candidate-validate, draft-publish), verifying retained documents against the exact stamp and digest they were written with. Corpus, candidateValidation and managedPublication expose adapters maps answering both plain and released handler ids, and the first-party retained-harness replay path verifies the existing artifact and reproduces its original digest. The public compileHarness options do not accept an output format override and its ordinary result preserves the released literal type. Default writers, public constants (KB_FORMAT, KB_OPERATIONS, MACHINE_PROTOCOL, CODEX_PROSE_PROFILE, CLAUDE_PROSE_PROFILE, CORPUS_INSPECT_HANDLER, CANDIDATE_VALIDATE_HANDLER, DRAFT_PUBLISH_HANDLER), host bindings and lifecycle retry keys continue to emit exact 3.8.1 shapes and digests while WRITE_PLAIN_NAMES is false.
